'''2003 Oklahoma State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held at Wizards Asylum in Tulsa, Oklahoma, on 28 June 2003.<ref name="pc-us03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Scott Manley]] was the tournament director.<ref name="pc-us03" />

The [[Players Committee]]'s 2003 State, Provincial and National Championships were the Level 1 events of its 2003 Championship Circuit; each awarded a bye into the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]].<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Tulsa, Oklahoma
* '''Dates:''' 28 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Wizards Asylum, Tulsa<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Time:''' 11am<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Fee:''' Free<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Scott Manley]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
